title: Plan2Agent context engineering Codex A/B result

scenarioId.description: Copy the supplied scenario id exactly.

decision.description: ask only for unresolved product questions; draft_spec when Gate A answers are complete; execute for implementation; collect_evidence for missing closeout evidence; return_gate_b only when product meaning or the approved contract must change; block for an authority or infrastructure stop that cannot be corrected inside the current contract.

executionMode.description: Use not_applicable outside mode selection. Direct is one bounded owner/change, Planned is one owner with two to five ordered recovery checkpoints, and Orchestrated is for multiple ownership or dependency boundaries.

questions.description: Select only unresolved identifiers from question_catalog; do not include already answered facts.

preservedRequirements.description: Select applicable identifiers from requirement_catalog that the next artifact or action must preserve.

checkpoints.description: Ordered checkpoint identifiers selected from checkpoint_catalog. Empty unless Planned recovery checkpoints are required.

requiredEvidence.description: Select every applicable identifier from evidence_catalog.

forbiddenActions.description: Select every applicable action identifier from forbidden_action_catalog that would violate this case.

ownerCount.description: Number of work-item owners: 0 outside execution, 1 for Direct/Planned or owner closeout, and the number of owned work items for Orchestrated. Do not add a separate count for the foreground integration coordinator.

requiresIsolation.description: True only when separate workspaces/worktrees are required for independently write-capable owners; false for an ordinary single-owner run.

serialIntegration.description: True only for multi-owner Orchestrated work whose accepted changes must be integrated into the canonical branch one at a time by the foreground owner. It is false for Direct and Planned work.

closeReady.description: True only when every required implementation, verification, visual, and accessibility item is already evidenced.

returnToGateB.description: True only when completing the work requires changing product meaning, acceptance, approved scope, non-goals, must-preserve items, or an external authority boundary. Missing implementation or closeout evidence alone is false.
